{{Short description|FIFA World Cup group}} {{Use mdy dates|date=December 2025}} {{Use American English|date=November 2025}} Group L of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] took place from June 17 to 27, 2026.{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/1be9ce37eb98fcc5/original/FWC26-Match-Schedule_English.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 26 – Match Schedule |publisher=[[FIFA]] |date=February 4, 2024 |access-date=February 4, 2024}} The group consisted of [[England national football team|England]], [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]], [[Ghana national football team|Ghana]], and [[Panama national football team|Panama]]. England finished as group leaders, with Croatia finishing as runners-up after crucial victories against Panama and Ghana in their subsequent two group games. Both teams advanced to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]]. Ghana finished in third place, and were able to advance as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|top eight third-place teams]]. Panama were eliminated after losing two group games, and would go on to lose all three group games without scoring a goal.{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 Regulations |publisher=FIFA |date=May 2025 |access-date=June 7, 2025 |archive-date=June 23, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250623212158/https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |url-status=live}} ==Teams== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !rowspan=2| Draw position !rowspan=2| Team !rowspan=2| Pot !rowspan=2| Confederation !rowspan=2| Method of

K]], [[DR Congo national football team|DR Congo]]. * The runner-up of Group L, [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]], advanced to play the runner-up of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K|Group K]], [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]]. * The third-place team of Group L, [[Ghana national football team|Ghana]], advanced to play the winner of [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K|Group K]], [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]], as one of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Ranking of third-place teams|eight best third-place teams]] from the group stage. ==Matches== All times listed are local. ===England vs Croatia=== The teams had previously met in eleven previous matches, including a [[2018 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Croatia vs England|2–1 semi-final win]] in [[2018 FIFA World Cup|2018]] for Croatia to advance to their [[2018 FIFA World Cup final|first final]].{{cite web|title=England vs. Croatia Head-to-Head in the World Cups|url=https://www.thesoccerworldcups.com/head_to_head/england_vs_croatia.php|website=The Soccer World Cups|access-date=6 December 2025}} Their most recent meeting was in the [[UEFA Euro 2020]] group stage, with England winning [[UEFA Euro 2020 Group D#England vs Croatia|1–0]].{{cite web|title=England national football team: record v Croatia|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/england/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Croatia|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}} In the 12th minute, England were awarded a penalty after [[Luka Modric]] fouled [[Noni Madueke]] with a kick inside the penalty area. [[Harry Kane]] took the penalty which was saved down low to his left by Croatian goalkeeper [[Dominik Livaković]]. The penalty had to be re-taken as Livaković was judged to have moved off his line before it was kicked, Kane again took the penalty and scored into the right of the net to put England into a 1–0 lead. In the 36th minute [[Martin Baturina]] made it 1–1 with a right foot shot to the top left corner of the net from outside the penalty area on the right which England goalkeeper [[Jordan Pickford]] got a hand to but couldn't prevent from going into the net. In the 42nd minute, England went back in front when Kane headed to the left of the net after making a run to meet a corner from the right by [[Declan Rice]]. With his second goal, Kane equalled [[Gary Lineker]]’s goals record for [[England at the FIFA World Cup|England at the World Cup]] with 10 goals.{{cite web|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/harry-kane-world-cup-goals-gary-lineker-england-croatia-b2997929.html|title= Harry Kane equals all-time England World Cup record after first-half double against Croatia|date=17 June 2026|work=The Independent |accessdate=18 June 2026}} Five minutes later it was 2–2 when [[Petar Musa]] fired to the net from the left inside the penalty area after a header back to him from [[Ivan Perišić]].{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/jun/17/england-croatia-world-cup-2026-group-l-match-report|title= England surge to thrilling opening win in World Cup cracker with Croatia|date=17 June 2026|work=Guardian |accessdate=18 June 2026}} England went back in front, two minutes into the second half when [[Jude Bellingham]] received the ball on the right before cutting in and shooting right footed low to the left corner of the net from the right of the penalty area. It was 4–2 in the 85th minute when substitute [[Marcus Rashford]] received the ball on the left of the penalty area before cutting in on his right foot and shooting low to the right corner of the net.{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cp36z3qpzrxt|title= England 4 Croatia 2|date=17 June 2026|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=18 June 2026}}

[[Bastian Dankert]] ([[German Football Association|Germany]]) |} ===England vs Ghana=== [[File:Harry Kane 9 England v Ghana at 2026 Fifa World Cup by YantsImages 06.jpg|thumb|right|During the match between England and Ghana]] England had previously faced Ghana only once, a 1–1 friendly draw in 2011.{{cite web|title=England national football team: record v Ghana|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/england/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Ghana|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}} In a game of few chances, in the 66th minute [[Jordan Pickford]] collided with [[Prince Kwabena Adu]] outside the penalty area with a free awarded to Pickford.{{cite web|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/england-ghana-world-cup-2026-result-b3001698.html|title= Dismal England serve up World Cup Shocker to highlight old problem|date=23 June 2026|work=The Independent |accessdate=24 June 2026}} In the 78th minute Ghana had a potential penalty not awarded, [[Ezri Konsa]] dived in to challenge Prince Kwabena Adu in the penalty area, bringing him down without making any contact with the ball.{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cx2j74xqy7jt|title= England 0 Ghana 0|date=23 June 2026|work=BBC Sport |accessdate=24 June 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cd6e3gvnnzwo|title='VAR went for a coffee' – should Ghana have had penalty against England?|date=22 June 2026|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=24 June 2026}} [[Bukayo Saka]] had a low shot from the right saved by Ghana goalkeeper [[Benjamin Asare]]. [[Nico O'Reilly]] also headed against the bar from six yards out after a cross from [[Marcus Rashford]] from the right with [[Harry Kane]] shooting the rebound over the bar, with the match finishing 0–0.

[[Bastian Dankert]] ([[German Football Association|Germany]]) |} ===Panama vs England=== The teams had only met once before, when England defeated debutant Panama [[2018 FIFA World Cup Group G#England vs Panama|6–1]] in a group stage match of the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]].{{cite web|title=Panama national football team: record v England|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/panama/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/England|website=11v11.com|access-date=December 6, 2025}} In the 1st minute, [[Tomás Rodríguez (footballer)|Tomás Rodríguez]] had the chance to put Panama ahead with a right-footed shot from outside the box but it was saved in the centre of the goal by [[Jordan Pickford]]. Then in the 8th minute, [[Marcus Rashford]] had a chance to put the Three Lions ahead with a right-footed shot from outside the box but it was saved in the bottom left corner by [[Orlando Mosquera]] and then [[Bukayo Saka]] missed his right-footed shot from the centre of the box which was too high and wide following a corner kick. In the 15th minute, Saka had another chance to put England ahead with a left-footed shot from the right side of the box which was close but he missed it to the right of the goal. In the 22nd minute, [[Jude Bellingham]] had an attempt at putting the Three Lions ahead but his right-footed shot from long-range on the right was too high and went wide of the right-side of the goal and Saka's left-footed shot from the centre of the box was blocked. Following the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Breaks|drinks break]], [[José Luis Rodríguez (footballer, born 1998)|José Luis Rodríguez]] had his left-footed shot from the centre of the box saved in the bottom left corner by Pickford in the 26th minute and [[Carlos Harvey]]'s right-footed shot from a difficult angle on the right was close but missed it to the right-hand side of the goal in the 28th minute. [[Nico O'Reilly]] then missed his attempt at putting England ahead in the 33rd minute with a header from the centre of the box which he missed to the left-hand side of the goal and [[Elliot Anderson (footballer)|Elliot Anderson]] had his right-footed shot from outside the box in the centre of the goal saved by Mosquera in the 35th minute. Rashford then missed his header from the left side of the six-yard box was just too high in the 38th minute and he also missed with a right-footed shot from outside of the box to the right of the six-yard box from a direct free-kick in the 48th minute.{{Cite web |title=England 2-0 Panama: Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane score as Three Lions top group |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cq5186pg2qqt |access-date=2026-06-29 |website=BBC Sport |language=en-GB}} In the 55th minute, Rashford had the first chance of the second-half with a left-footed shot from a difficult angle on the left which was close but missed to left-hand side of the penalty area and José Luis Rodríguez missed his right-footed shot from outside the box which was close in the 56th minute but missed the top right corner. [[Harry Kane]] then had his right-footed shot in the 57th minute from the centre of the box saved in the top centre of the goal by Mosqeura and Bellingham then opened the scoring for England in the 62nd minute with a left-footed shot from the centre of the box after a corner kick from Saka. [[Michael Amir Murillo]] the missed the chance to equalise for Panama with a right-footed shot from the centre of the six-yard box missed to the left-hand side in the 64th minute and Kane had his left-footed shot in the 66th minute from the centre of the box blocked. Kane then scored the Three Lions' second goal of the match in the 67th minute with a header from the centre of the box to the top-left corner of the net after a cross from Bellingham this made Kane England's record goalscorer at [[FIFA World Cup|FIFA World Cups]] beating [[Gary Lineker]]'s record of 10 goals with Kane now on 11 goals at World Cups. [[Azarias Londoño]] missed his left-footed shot from outside the box which was close but missed to the right-hand side of the goal in the 74th minute and [[Ismael Díaz (footballer, born 1997)|Ismael Díaz]] missed his header from the centre of the box which was too high. Ismael Díaz then had his right-footed shot from the right-side of the box blocked in the 75th minute and Carlos Harvey then had his header from the centre of the box in the 76th minute blocked. Amir Murillo had his right-footed shot from the centre of the box blocked in the 76th minute and Ismael Díaz missed his right-footed shot from the centre of the box which was too high. Ismael Díaz then thought that he had pulled a goal back for Panama in the 78th minute but it was disallowed for an [[Offside (association football)|offside]] in the build-up and Rashford missed his right-footed shot from the left side of the box which missed to the left-hand side of the goal in the 87th minute. Ismael Díaz then missed his right-footed shot from outside the box which was close but missed to right-hand side of the goal in the 90th minute and substitute [[Noni Madueke]] had his right-footed shot from the centre of the box saved in the centre of the goal by Mosquera in the 91st minute. [[Eric Davis (Panamanian footballer)|Eric Davis]] then missed his left-footed shot from a difficult angle and long-range on the right was close but missed to the right-hand side of the goal in the 94th minute and another substitute [[Eberechi Eze]] had his left-footed shot from outside the box blocked in the 94th minute with the last action of the match at the [[MetLife Stadium]] in [[East Rutherford, New Jersey|East Rutherford]]. This result meant that England won the group and would face the 3rd-placed team from [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K|Group K]], [[DR Congo national football team|DR Congo]] at the [[Mercedes-Benz Stadium]] in [[Atlanta]] on 1 July.{{Cite web |title=England 2-0 Panama: Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane score as Three Lions top group |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cq5186pg2qqt |access-date=2026-06-29 |website=BBC Sport |language=en-GB}} With three additional defeats, Panama now has six overall losses from its two World Cup appearances, remaining winless in its return after [[2018 FIFA World Cup|8 years]], and left the tournament as the only team that failed to score a goal.
